articles.title: USMNT’s Final Friendlies Reveal a Team Primed for World Cup Battle
articles.summary: The U.S. men’s national team wrapped up pre-World Cup friendlies with a resilient draw against Germany and a win over Senegal. Christian Pulisic ended his goal drought, and the squad showed mental toughness. But defensive gaps remain a concern ahead of the tournament.

articles.title: Trump’s Knicks Finals Appearance Sparks Excitement and Anxiety in New York
articles.summary: President Donald Trump will attend Game 3 of the NBA Finals at Madison Square Garden, becoming the first sitting president to do so. Invited by Knicks owner James Dolan, his visit has stirred mixed reactions in a city where he remains deeply unpopular. The Knicks lead the series 2-0.

articles.title: M&S Launches 1,000-Strong Traineeship to Combat Youth Unemployment Crisis
articles.summary: Marks & Spencer is creating 1,000 paid traineeships for 16-to-24-year-olds in the UK and Ireland, targeting the soaring number of young people not in employment, education, or training (NEETs). The six-month program offers a pathway to store management without requiring a degree.
